messages.author: 48f24841e806e6c6
messages.subject: Readying a new release
parts:
Hi,

A new release of rApache is forthcoming, and I'm wondering what you
all think if I eliminate the ROutputError directive and related
functions. I never really could get the feature working the way I
wanted, and now it's messing with the ability to host Rook
applications (a new feature). If I yank it out, then all warnings and
errors will be logged through the apache logging subsystem.

So? Any thoughts or concerns?

Jeff

messages.author: 3ea57457192f4f3b
messages.subject: Re: Readying a new release
parts:
While you're add it, could you add support for parsing of PUT methods. HTTP PUT has the same request format as HTTP POST. So I comes down to replacing





if (strcmp(MR_Request.r->method,"POST") != 0) {



		MR_Request.postTable = NULL;



		MR_Request.filesVar = R_NilValue;



		return R_NilValue;



}

with







if (strcmp(MR_Request.r->method,"POST") != 0 && strcmp(MR_Request.r->method,"PUT") != 0) {



		MR_Request.postTable = NULL;



		MR_Request.filesVar = R_NilValue;



		return R_NilValue;



}
